text: In the assigned Convert_whitespace cleanup, the author identifies an unsigned counter wrapping from0 to 4294967295. BenC accepts D234299 but explicitly says the old code was not incorrect because the wrapped counter was never used again. The accepted source adds outer nonzero guards around post-decrement loops; a positive countdown can still wrap when its final condition fails, after emitting the intended output, and those local counters are not read afterward. Preserve this review rebuttal alongside the accepted diagnostic cleanup. This is a scoped historical disposition, not a reproduced output failure, an infinite-loop finding or general permission to ignore integer diagnostics. Existing source analysis already covers the loop behavior; this addendum adds the reviewer outcome. Shared Bug 1941552 is missing comment25, so this partial note adds no complete-audit credit. No runtime, analyzer, build or tests ran.
title: Convert_whitespace review accepts the guard without confirming a runtime bug
